Build & Test failure on PR #1391 was plugin-commands-gate (executor.md 167 lines > 165 cap; task ids in executor.md and operator-dispatch.md adopter text). Fixed locally in commit 8f62e714; plugin command tests pass 313/313; reviewers approved (code, test, security; Codex code review hit quota so the Claude-native reviewer ran). next-step then stopped at Step 10.5 rebase-conflict with no conflicting files: git status shows an unstaged deletion of .ai-sdlc/attestations/ca9b99dc2607d61996988e3605e897aa55c07b9a.v6.dsse.json and an untracked .ai-sdlc/transcript-leaves/69f9bec3f4dcaadebc1249ab09c915e4d1ef6373.jsonl. Executors may not edit .ai-sdlc, so the tree needs cleaning by someone with that authority. Review notes to carry: executor.md says to release the claim after iterate-needed but the CLI refuses release while done/ holds a verdict (resume takes over per DEC-0147); release guard fails open when workDir is not the repo root.
